review.posthog_relevance: Supports warehouse ingestion workflow by preserving PostHog-supplied URLs during metadata-only updates, preventing accidental URL clearing when warehouse credentials are absent.
review.reason: Adds a serializer guard and corresponding test to preserve warehouse URL patterns when updating warehouse metadata without credentials, supporting warehouse ingestion compatibility.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on supplied observations; no independent verification of actual warehouse connector compatibility or production behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, conservative group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier requires assessment of broader systemic impact and implementation completeness.
